guard: the auth callout mints a person's manager view with owner-mode seat control from the ledger row's kind, and an agent's with none
why: The kind reaches the manager-caller mint only through this one argument. The smoke imports the auth src directly.

mutations.name: the manager-caller mint drops the row kind
mutations.find: { capabilities: caps, lifecycleUid: t.act.lifecycleUid, managerInstanceId: instanceId, ...binding, ...(acl.kind !== undefined ? { ledgerKind: acl.kind } : {}) },
mutations.replace: { capabilities: caps, lifecycleUid: t.act.lifecycleUid, managerInstanceId: instanceId, ...binding },
mutations.expectRed: the callout mints a person's manager view with owner-mode input

mutations.name: every manager-caller mint is a person's
mutations.find: { capabilities: caps, lifecycleUid: t.act.lifecycleUid, managerInstanceId: instanceId, ...binding, ...(acl.kind !== undefined ? { ledgerKind: acl.kind } : {}) },
mutations.replace: { capabilities: caps, lifecycleUid: t.act.lifecycleUid, managerInstanceId: instanceId, ...binding, ledgerKind: "interactive" as const },
mutations.expectRed: the callout mints an agent's manager view with no input or interrupt row
